subject: Friday demos
title: Every project demos *on Friday.*
standfirst: Sets the one rule that applies to every Cooper Labs engagement from October: a demo of working software every Friday, with the client in the room.

blocks.heading: The rule *in one paragraph*
blocks.body: Every project demos on Friday, from the first week to the last. The demo shows software that runs, not slides; it lasts thirty minutes; the client is there; what is decided is written in the project channel before the end of the day. A week without a demo is a week we do not invoice.

bullets: See the product grow every week and decide on what they see, not on a plan.
A fixed rhythm; scope cut on Friday rather than discovered in the last week.
Every proposal names the six or twelve demos it promises, and the phase gate sits on one of them.

blocks.source: Owners confirmed at the studio meeting of 11 Sep 2026.
